items.title: India's 8th Trade Policy Review at WTO
items.whyInNews: India completed its 8th trade policy review at the World Trade Organization (WTO) in Geneva, with a focus on its trade policies and their impact on the global economy.
items.summary: The review was conducted by the WTO's Trade Policy Review Body, which assesses the trade policies of member countries. India's trade policy review was led by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. The review highlighted India's efforts to increase trade and investment, and its commitment to the WTO's principles. The review also discussed India's trade agreements with other countries, including the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP).

items.summary: The US has imposed 10% tariffs on goods imported from India, effective immediately. This decision was made under Section 301 of the Trade Act.
